essence: The practice involves directing concealed upward pressure through the heart and throat.
When the skull is pierced, the life-breath moves to the stainless state.
Attaining this state yields knowledge of self, supreme reality, and all beings.
Another method is to be practiced directly and continually.
This practice directs upward pressure through the nameless point, navel, and heart.
